scope: Official organizers, venues and ticketing partners for Fortnite physical events in France and Europe

principles.direct_first: Venue/organizer direct source is preferred for event access, address, sessions and onsite rules; official ticketing partner is preferred for actual inventory/category state.
principles.engine_not_organizer: A ticketing platform is not automatically the event organizer.
principles.territory_bound: A provider confirms only its own listed event/territory and cannot establish global competitive rules outside its scope.
principles.session_category_scope: Providers may confirm a specific session/category without changing global event status.
principles.onsite_scope: Age, ID, check-in, last-entry, re-entry, bag/security, queue and accessibility rules are accepted only at the exact event/session/venue scope explicitly published.
principles.partner_guard: A brand partner can confirm only the activation/viewing party/stand it directly organizes or publishes, not unrelated Fortnite events.

discovery_policy.promotion_rule: Add a provider only after it directly publishes or sells access to a verified Fortnite physical event. A logo/sponsorship mention alone is insufficient.
discovery_policy.red_bull_rule: Red Bull pages/accounts may become provider records only for a specific official Fortnite event or activation they directly organize/publish.
discovery_policy.access_rule: A provider discovered via ticket sales is not automatically authoritative for onsite access rules; can_confirm must explicitly cover the field and source scope.
